summary: Full linked-list destructor. Walks a singly-linked list from the head pointer in *this, reading each node's next pointer at +0x4 and a free-data flag at +0x8. For each node whose flag is non-zero and whose data pointer at +0x0 is non-null, it first calls an empty stub and then frees the node's data block. Every node is then freed. Finally the list bookkeeping fields (head at +0x0, tail at +0x4, current at +0x8, count at +0xC) are zeroed and 0 is returned.

operations.description: Traverse the singly-linked list from the head stored at *this while the current node pointer is non-null.
Capture the node's data pointer (v5 = *v3) and free flag (node+0x8) before advancing to the next node via node+0x4.
Per node: free attached data only when the free-data flag at node+0x8 is non-zero AND the data pointer at node+0x0 is non-null.
Call EmptyStub_0170 before freeing flagged node data.
Free the flagged node's data block via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf on every iteration.
Zero the list head, tail, current and count fields at this+0x0, +0x4, +0x8 and +0xC.
Return 0 after the list is emptied.
